name: patch_text
description: Replaces a substring within a text field of a game, character, NPC, or memory. Use this to make targeted edits to long descriptions or notes without rewriting the entire field. The search string must match exactly (case-sensitive).

entity_type.description: The type of entity to edit.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the entity.

game.description: The slug of the game. Required for character, npc, and memory; omit for game.

field.description: The text field to edit. Common values: 'notes' (character, npc, game), 'description' (game), 'memory' (memory).

search.description: The exact substring to find (case-sensitive). Copy it verbatim from the record.

replacement.description: The text to replace the matched substring with.
